title: Home
summary: The one Home in the Platform sidebar context: attention from one server read, the Platform ready checklist for platform admins while it is incomplete, and the products as ST-36 cards with a Cards/Table toggle and facets. The Products page and the summary tiles are gone.
compare: The sidebar is the Platform context: a context header (Platform, 3 products, switcher chevrons), then Home, Members, Connections, Settings, Packages, Status, Activity, and no product sections.

Needs attention lists only broken things (failed resync, missing required secret, expiring store credential), each with a tone pill, the product's logo and name, one sentence and one action link. Integration progress never appears here.
Attention comes from one server read (GET /manage/api/attention); the old summary tiles (Products, Need attention, Linked to a repository) are gone.

Platform ready shows only to platform admins and only while incomplete: open rows first with their one action (here only Store connections: Steam has no Steamworks publisher key), done rows folded into one line, and an '8 of 9 done' meter on the right. Team access is done because the platform has 6 members (Members in the Platform sidebar, Tomás Okafor on DJDL); the task only shows while you're the only member.

Product cards keep ST-36's shape: logo, name as the one link, slug in mono, an attention pill at the right edge only when something needs attention, and one row of glyphs, one per feature in canonical order (not one per service), each with a tooltip and an accessible name; the issue dot sits on the feature with the problem. No facts, no footer, no healthy pill. This amends ST-44's acceptance wording 'service icons' to feature icons: Ship builds is one package glyph, never release, distribution and update.

DJDL shows five glyphs (Licensing, Managed config with a warning dot, Ship builds, Sign-in, Cloud Sync); Diceroll four (Licensing, Managed config, Ship builds with a danger dot for the failed resync and the Google Play key, Commerce: its own store glyph in the distribution green, last); Polaris Key two (Ship builds, Sign-in). Diceroll has no Sign-in, so no Cloud Sync, matching products.features.

The Cards/Table segmented control sits on the Products heading line, right-aligned; the Filter products field, the 'Integration verified' facet (ST-44's Setup complete facet, renamed to Verified) and the Needs attention facet sit above the grid. 'Setup complete' appears nowhere.

Phone: the sidebar folds into the menu button, the top-bar search becomes an icon but Filter products stays as a full-width field, New product takes a full-width row, attention rows stack with their action link (24 px hit height) on its own line, and each card shows one pip per feature beside the name, named for screen readers.
Copy: the done item is 'Platform packages' (glossary: Packages, not package feeds); the Store connections row names only the problem, not a partial channel list.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Fixed: Platform ready now agrees with the 6 members shown elsewhere (8 of 9), and cards, pips and the switcher speak in features, one glyph each.

findings.issue: Platform ready's open task Team access said 'You're the only member', contradicting Members 6 in the Platform sidebar, Diceroll's 4 members and Tomás Okafor joining DJDL.
findings.resolution: Team access folded into the Done line as 'Team access: 6 members'; the meter reads 8 of 9 and Store connections is the one open task.

findings.issue: Cards showed one icon per service (7 for DJDL's 5 features, 6 for Diceroll's 4) while every other screen speaks in the six features; the three Ship builds icons mapped to nothing a person sees.
findings.resolution: One glyph per feature in canonical order on the cards and the phone pips (and the same in the wizard preview and the switcher): DJDL 5, Diceroll 4, Polaris Key 2. Ship builds is one package glyph carrying the danger dot for the failed resync and the Google Play key. Each glyph has a tooltip and an aria-label with the feature name; each pip row has role=img and a label listing the features. Lead: record this as an amendment to ST-44's acceptance line ('service icons' becomes feature icons).

findings.issue: Phone: attention action links were 20 px tall and card name links 18 px; Cards/Table took a row of its own; the Filter products field disappeared on phone.
findings.resolution: Attention action links get a 24 px minimum hit height and sit at their own width on phone. Cards/Table moved onto the Products heading line, right-aligned. Filter products stays on phone as a full-width field. The card name link needs no change: its ::after stretches over the whole card, so its hit area is the card.

findings.issue: Copy: '+ Integration' didn't say what it filters; the Store connections task listed only Google Play and Steam; 'Platform package feeds' used the old word.
findings.resolution: Facet renamed 'Integration verified' (ST-44 turns the Setup complete facet into Verified). Store connections now reads 'Steam has no Steamworks publisher key yet, so Diceroll's Steam channel can't upload builds.' Done item renamed 'Platform packages'.
